title: scene-server: doc and spec citation drift
description:
scene-server: doc and citation drift (batch 8b review, JMAP-0x0q.24/.26/.29/.54, JMAP-38uq.10/.11). Line numbers are identical at jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 and HEAD 33702a5.

- src/avatar.rs:423-428 update_avatar doc lists the `updated` echo as joinedAt/position/orientation on re-entry, normalized orientation, else null; it omits the server-set leftAt now echoed on leave/eject (L546-550).
- README.md:184-185: "Return Err for a storage failure, not Ok(None), or the client sees notFound"; both blob_size callers (asset.rs create, object.rs visualRef) now return invalidProperties on Ok(None).
- tests/region_set.rs:678 cites L1230 and :869 cites L1245 for "The region id does not exist"; the rows are now draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00 L1328 (update table) and L1343 (destroy table).
- tests/region_set.rs:760: "L1240-1242 the region id is in destroyed"; L1240-1242 are oldState/newState/created, the destroyed array is L1244-1246.
- tests/region_set.rs:262: cites L1174 "Quaternion must be [x, y, z, w] with magnitude within epsilon of 1.0", text no longer in spec; the row is L1270 ("finite components and non-zero magnitude; ...").
- tests/avatar_set.rs:457: cites L2384 for "regionId is missing" and L2385 for visualRef/visualType; they are L2383 and L2384 (L2385 is the regionId-access row).
close_reason: Batch 9: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at df7e2035
